summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **Root cause (from read-only audit, not yet fixed):** This is not a backend/data problem — it's a client-side stale-state bug.  - Backend (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`) already scopes every read/write correctly by `user_id` derived from the session cookie (`and(eq(watchlists.id, id), eq(watchlists.user_id, userId))`), and its own auth middleware correctly re-validates the session token and injects `X-User-Id`. No missing feature, no anonymous fallback, no localStorage — the backend is solid. - The bug is in `client/src/pages/Watch
